gaps_identified.description: Armenian, Georgian, Cherokee, and extended Cyrillic/Greek characters not in homoglyph normalization table
gaps_identified.fix: Expanded _HOMOGLYPH_MAP with 21 new characters covering Armenian (6), Georgian (2), Cherokee (1), extended Cyrillic (5), Greek extended (2), Roman numerals (3), Latin extended (2)

gaps_identified.description: Combining marks (U+034F, U+0361, U+0489) inserted between characters to break regex tokens
gaps_identified.fix: Added combining mark stripping (Mn and Me unicode categories) after zero-width stripping in normalize_text()

gaps_identified.description: 10 additional invisible characters not in original stripping set (Hangul fillers, Khmer vowels, Braille blank, etc.)
SSNs expressed as spoken words ('one two three, four five, six seven eight nine') not caught by digit-only regex
gaps_identified.fix: Added _SSN_WORDS_RE pattern matching 9 consecutive number words with separators

gaps_identified.description: PII encoded in base64 near context keywords (SSN:, password:, etc.) bypasses regex patterns
gaps_identified.fix: Added _BASE64_PII_RE pattern detecting base64 strings after PII context keywords

gaps_identified.description: Benign filler text between injection keywords dilutes keyword density below detection threshold
gaps_identified.fix: Behavioral escalation scoring now uses per-hit minimum score (0.15/keyword) to resist padding dilution

gaps_identified.description: PII hidden in acrostics, code comments, JSON keys, or split across sentences
gaps_identified.notes: Requires ML-based PII detection (Presidio NER, custom model). Beyond regex capability. Production upgrade path.

gaps_identified.description: Agents can request capability escalation through standard endpoints without explicit blocking
gaps_identified.notes: Agent security framework enforces authorization but the campaign tests bypass agent endpoints. Requires integration with main pipeline for agent-originated requests.

gaps_identified.description: Replacing trigger words with synonyms (disregard/bypass/circumvent for ignore) evades keyword-based regex
gaps_identified.notes: Fundamentally requires ML-based detection (DeBERTa). Regex cannot cover all synonyms. This is the designed role of L3 Adaptive layer.

gaps_identified.description: Half base64 + half plaintext instructions evade both encoding detection and plaintext regex
gaps_identified.notes: Requires recursive decoding in L2 regex preprocessing (decode base64 segments, re-scan decoded content). Production upgrade path.
